title: The Last Use Move
goal: Recognize that the final call taking ownership does not need to clone.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Morning: Move Semantics

hints: The first call must clone because note is needed afterwards.
On the second call, note is never used again, so moving ownership is free.
explanation: The first call must clone `note` because the variable is accessed again later. On the second call, `note` reaches its final use. Moving ownership directly into `consume_log` avoids a redundant heap allocation. Passing `&note` produces type mismatch `E0308` because `consume_log` requires an owned `String`.
